#include <cstdio>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    const int MOD = 1000000007;
    int n;
    scanf("%d", &n);
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(n + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; ++j) {
            if (j != i) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i][j-1]) % MOD;
            if (i != 0) dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i-1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int j = n; j >= 0; --j) {
        for (int i = j - 1; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
            ans = (ans + dp[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
